content: Isilaehi adi Bepaŋdi yehitubu-lodawek yoŋa ninadigiŋ

Bepaŋ, me nadisukilitihinit mokit adi agaŋ indi’walaŋ kwetnineŋ iŋoŋ bugiŋ, buŋa metamgeye inditok mik tinimiiŋ. Adi datok yoŋa yoke uŋgoniŋ maguŋ u tubukadaka tigiŋ, kaŋ yoke uŋgoniŋ u geŋgeŋnit tilak. Unduŋ tiŋa Jelusalem adi tubukadaka hinek tigiŋ.
Adi metamgeye eŋ kwanai-megeye widihikumuŋgiŋ, kaŋ bagi kalaŋkatak tiŋa kale moihidi foloohik dabaŋ u nagiŋ.
Memik hekidi metamgeye widihi-kumumbune naŋgathikdi kwatneeŋ Jelusalem maaneŋ ime nabugoŋ wodiŋa uguk. Kaŋ uŋoŋ foloohik dabaŋ beŋa wooŋ yehiwenefuladok nebek nemu hatigiŋ.
Metam-bop indi itowamneŋ yamaiŋgoŋ itowiiŋ heki adi nibugegeeŋ ninimpekit tiŋa mede kadakahi niniiŋ.
Yahwe, du inditok kwihitanimiŋa nai kweheyeniŋ undugoŋ be hatibaaŋ? Kwihitagedi kudup dalak unduŋ daaŋ kumuŋ mu tibaak be?
Du adi toboniŋ metambop du’walaŋkade wooŋ mulelem mu tigamuŋa ganiutumbaaŋ sigilulum tigamiiŋ, metam undihidok adidili kwihita tiyembeŋ.
Metambop adi kuyeŋ metamgeye indi nindihikumuŋgiŋ, tiŋa kwetnik nimguŋ u tubukadaka hinek tigiŋ.

Du tiyaugene mamani-papaniyedi koom kadakaniŋ tigiŋ wondok kibikoŋ nobuniŋ malabumuŋ i tubu-udanenimuliweŋ. Indi saŋiniŋnik agaŋ fofoye tilak, unduŋ doktiŋa du fiit siloŋ tobogoŋ tinimiŋa saŋiniŋ pilap nimbeŋ.

O Bepaŋ, du da kubugoŋdi nihitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ hati ninigitaŋ. Ale wohogegigitdok nadiŋa nihitubu-lodaweŋ. Kotigoŋ ninigila kadakaniŋnik hogohogok u wanakaŋ tumolokutnimbeŋ, kaŋ indi wohoge ganintilonim.

Dediŋ doktiŋa mebop nolidi indiŋ nininadiiŋ, “Bepaŋhik deŋgoŋ hatak?” Adi kwanai-megeye widihikumuŋgiŋ, unduŋ doktiŋa dubo kibibo naŋgathik diniŋ tuwaŋiŋ metambop noli u yehitubu-kadakaune gabunimdok woomam.
Du me yot fafaŋeniŋneŋ hakiiŋ’walaŋ makat koyonehik u nadiyembeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa memik hekidi me agaŋ kumuŋ titiŋdok yenindapmagiŋ u saŋiniŋge uŋgoniŋdi yehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ yanagileŋ.
Memik heki woŋ adi medehaki ganiŋgiŋ. Unduŋ doktiŋa Wapum, dubo kibibo titiŋhik kadakaniŋ wendok kibikoŋ nai 7 wondok tuwot tubu-udaneyembeŋ.

Du unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ metamgeye hogohogok, da’walaŋ dompageye nabugoŋ hatiyam, indi helemahelemaŋ welemomooŋ nadiŋa ganiutumbayaneem. Kaŋ yalakiniyedibo tomboyoula wohoge yotiloune dapmandapmaŋnit mokit haliwooŋ halaak.
